result.summary: The interface is well-structured with minor visual and contrast inconsistencies.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip appears active, but the displayed content features ramen and poké.
issues.suggestion: Update feed content to reflect the active filter or keep 'All' selected by default.

issues.description: Secondary white text on the green promo banner has low visual contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the green background gradient to ensure sufficient text readability.
